population.label: Official funded positions
population.note: One row per official funded position (official_asp_positions in a FUNDED_ERA experiment), joined to its exact funding decision (shadow_decision_id). Not the scored-forecast population used by the accuracy tabs.
exclusions: House Divided copies (competition_wagers) are never read.
Repeated checkpoint decisions are never read: each position joins only its funding decision.
Unfunded shadow and control experiments hold no counted positions.

scope.label: All official funded positions — all sports · all engines and policy eras

date_basis.label: Slate date (ET) of the funding decision
date_basis.note: Date filters use the Eastern slate date recorded on the governing decision (the game's ET slate), not the time the position was placed or settled.

methods.roi: Stake-weighted ROI = net profit / settled stake. Pushes and voids stay in the stake (their net is 0).
methods.roi_ci95: 95% percentile bootstrap: 4,000 resamples of settled wagers with a fixed seed; shown only when n ≥ 2. Wide intervals mean the slice cannot separate skill from noise.
methods.win_rate_ci95: Wilson score 95% interval on wins / (wins + losses); pushes and voids are excluded.
methods.expected_wins: Predicted vs observed use one denominator: settled wins and losses only (pushes and voids are refunded and excluded). The prediction is the selected-side probability of a win given a decided result: the recorded raw probability where the market cannot tie (MLB, CFB), and the derived non-tie probability pWin / (1 − pTie) for NFL, where ties are refunded. An NFL wager without a recorded tie probability is left out of the comparison, not guessed. The recorded raw probability and tie-aware return are shown unchanged.
methods.binding: Each position's funding decision must match its experiment, game, market and selected side. A decision that conflicts or cannot be resolved keeps the position and settlement but contributes no estimate or probability (listed under Missing, flagged).
methods.estimated_profit: Estimated at entry: Σ stake × recorded policy-adjusted return. Not a promise; it is what the recorded probability and entry price implied.
methods.exploratory: Band results are exploratory slices of a small sample, unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
methods.return_vs_confidence: Higher estimated return is not higher confidence: return = p × decimal odds − 1, so a longshot can carry a high return with a low win probability.
